name: smoosh
description: Editor-only surface, retired at M1. Smoosh is a Zig-core Native SDK app: the native CLI never reads this file, the Zig SDK resolves from a bun global install via .native/build/build.zig.zon, and @native-sdk/core exists solely to give the editor IntelliSense for the leftover src/core.ts. Delete this file, tsconfig.json, and src/core.ts together in M1.
